name: Image Viewer
author: KryonOS Team
description: High-performance digital image viewer for LilyGO T-Deck Plus and KryonOS devices. Displays PNG (with 8-bit alpha blending), JPEG (with hardware downscaling), and BMP images from Flash or MicroSD.
changelog: Initial release of Image Viewer featuring dual storage selection (Flash & SD Card), pre-flight metadata inspection, zoom/scale modes, pan navigation, trackball controls, and slideshow.
